voice.speaker: female
voice.effect:
Welcome, good girl. Find a place where you can relax completely and won't be disturbed.
Get comfortable, let your body settle, and when you're ready to slip under for me, press the button.
All you have to do is listen. My voice will do the rest.
voice.until:
Take one more slow breath for me. In... and out.
Good girl. Let's begin.
